import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧ 
  needle.size < 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Boolean (executable) version of the "match at position `i`" test.
    The inner `List.all` over `List.range needle.size` is the
    character-by-character comparison loop. -/
def matchesAtB (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    (List.range needle.size).all (fun j => haystack.getD (i + j) 0 == needle.getD j 0)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def naive_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Array Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle)).toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (result : Array Nat) (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i, i < result.size → matches_at haystack needle (result.getD i 0)) ∧
  (∀ i, matches_at haystack needle i → ∃ k, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k 0 = i)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem arr_getD {α : Type _} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) (h : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = a[i] := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem matchesAtB_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    matchesAtB haystack needle i = true ↔ matches_at haystack needle i := by
  simp [matchesAtB, matches_at, List.all_eq_true]

theorem mem_filter_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    i ∈ (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle) ↔
      matches_at haystack needle i := by
  rw [List.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (matchesAtB_iff haystack needle i).mp h.2
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, (matchesAtB_iff haystack needle i).mpr h⟩
    rw [List.mem_range]
    have h1 := h.1
    omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem naive_search_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (h_precond : naive_search_precond haystack needle) :
    naive_search_postcond haystack needle (naive_search haystack needle h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hi]
    have hi' : i < ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter
        (matchesAtB haystack needle)).length := by
      simpa [naive_search] using hi
    have heq : (naive_search haystack needle h_precond)[i] =
        ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle))[i] := by
      simp [naive_search]
    rw [heq]
    exact (mem_filter_iff haystack needle _).mp (List.getElem_mem hi')
  · intro i hmat
    have hmem : i ∈ (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle) :=
      (mem_filter_iff haystack needle i).mpr hmat
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkeq⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hmem
    have hk' : k < (naive_search haystack needle h_precond).size := by
      simpa [naive_search] using hk
    refine ⟨k, hk', ?_⟩
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hk']
    have heq : (naive_search haystack needle h_precond)[k] =
        ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle))[k] := by
      simp [naive_search]
    rw [heq]
    exact hkeq
  -- !benchmark @end proof

The naive search can be expressed declaratively: iterate over every candidate start position `i ∈ [0, haystack.size]` and keep those where a character-by-character comparison succeeds.

**Implementation plan:**
- Define a decidable Boolean version of the match test:
  `matchesAtB haystack needle i = decide (i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) && (List.range needle.size).all (fun j => haystack.getD (i+j) 0 == needle.getD j 0)`
  The `List.range needle.size |>.all ...` is exactly the inner comparison loop.
- The result is `((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle)).toArray`, i.e. the outer loop.

**Correctness plan:**
1. Lemma `matchesAtB_iff`: `matchesAtB haystack needle i = true ↔ matches_at haystack needle i`. This is the inner-loop invariant, discharged by `List.all_eq_true` + `List.mem_range`.
2. Lemma `mem_filter_iff`: `i ∈ filtered list ↔ matches_at haystack needle i`. The forward direction is immediate from `List.mem_filter`; the backward direction needs `i < haystack.size + 1`, which follows from `i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size` by `omega`. This handles the "iteration covers the whole search space" obligation.
3. Soundness: every element at a valid index is a member of the filtered list, hence a match.
4. Completeness: any match is a member of the list, so `List.mem_iff_getElem` provides the index.
5. A small helper `arr_getD` converts `Array.getD` to `getElem` when the index is in bounds.

```lean4
import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧ 
  needle.size < 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Boolean (executable) version of the "match at position `i`" test.
    The inner `List.all` over `List.range needle.size` is the
    character-by-character comparison loop. -/
def matchesAtB (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    (List.range needle.size).all (fun j => haystack.getD (i + j) 0 == needle.getD j 0)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def naive_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Array Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle)).toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def naive_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (result : Array Nat) (_ : naive_search_precond haystack needle) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i, i < result.size → matches_at haystack needle (result.getD i 0)) ∧
  (∀ i, matches_at haystack needle i → ∃ k, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k 0 = i)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem arr_getD {α : Type _} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) (h : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = a[i] := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem matchesAtB_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    matchesAtB haystack needle i = true ↔ matches_at haystack needle i := by
  simp [matchesAtB, matches_at, List.all_eq_true]

theorem mem_filter_iff (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) :
    i ∈ (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle) ↔
      matches_at haystack needle i := by
  rw [List.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (matchesAtB_iff haystack needle i).mp h.2
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, (matchesAtB_iff haystack needle i).mpr h⟩
    rw [List.mem_range]
    have h1 := h.1
    omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem naive_search_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (h_precond : naive_search_precond haystack needle) :
    naive_search_postcond haystack needle (naive_search haystack needle h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hi]
    have hi' : i < ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter
        (matchesAtB haystack needle)).length := by
      simpa [naive_search] using hi
    have heq : (naive_search haystack needle h_precond)[i] =
        ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle))[i] := by
      simp [naive_search]
    rw [heq]
    exact (mem_filter_iff haystack needle _).mp (List.getElem_mem hi')
  · intro i hmat
    have hmem : i ∈ (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle) :=
      (mem_filter_iff haystack needle i).mpr hmat
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkeq⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hmem
    have hk' : k < (naive_search haystack needle h_precond).size := by
      simpa [naive_search] using hk
    refine ⟨k, hk', ?_⟩
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hk']
    have heq : (naive_search haystack needle h_precond)[k] =
        ((List.range (haystack.size + 1)).filter (matchesAtB haystack needle))[k] := by
      simp [naive_search]
    rw [heq]
    exact hkeq
  -- !benchmark @end proof
```
